question: At the deployed descriptor geometry, can one locally owned production live-route process use the read-only remote vLLM endpoint over the existing SSH tunnel to record the one-to-eight-session matrix and sustain its largest passing bound for ten minutes, without crossing text between sessions during overload or observer reconnect?

may_establish: G4 local-route duration, round-robin fairness, session-local v2 429 semantics, and tunnel-inclusive transcript lag
G5 cross-session text isolation through overload and observer reconnect
does_not_establish: vLLM active or queued request counts
scope.latency_label: loopback production routes with remote vLLM over the SSH tunnel and tailnet; transcript lag includes network transit

production_path.service: one locally started loopback FastAPI process with live routes enabled
production_path.decoder: the real MOSS decoder through the production LiveServiceRuntime path
production_path.backend: the production VllmRunner with an explicitly supplied OpenAI-compatible vLLM base URL and model id
production_path.audio: hash-pinned real human speech replayed at wall-clock rate

frame_geometry.source: read at run time from both the run-owned local /api/live/descriptor and the read-only deployed /api/live/descriptor
frame_geometry.comparison: all deployed bound fields must match exactly before capture begins

run_owned_manifest.input: a provisional local provider manifest with the existing calibrated identity values
run_owned_manifest.output: a new finalized manifest inside the run evidence directory
run_owned_manifest.source_revision: the exact 40-character git HEAD at run start
run_owned_manifest.bounds_and_calibration: derive all finalizer arguments from the read-only deployed descriptor and provisional manifest; do not duplicate geometry or identity constants in runner code
required_checks: the finalized manifest source_revision equals the captured git HEAD
the production LiveProviderBundleConfig reader admits the finalized manifest
the local descriptor source_revision equals the captured git HEAD
the finalized manifest SHA-256 is recorded

endpoint_preflight.health: GET the endpoint origin /health and require HTTP 200
required_checks: the explicitly supplied selected model id appears in the /models response before the run
record a SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the before and after /models responses
record the explicit base URL and selected model id without recording credentials
a failed preflight aborts before local service startup
a failed closing probe makes the measurement non-passing rather than a slow-model result

latency.aggregation: compute each session independently; the run value is the maximum session p95
latency.reporting_rule: record p50, p95, max, and full per-session arrays under the tunnel-inclusive label; never present this figure as an isolated-GPU bound
latency.basis: 10.0 seconds retains ticket #3's frozen ceiling without moving a gate after endpoint availability. The result must state that its timing includes SSH tunnel and tailnet transit.

memory.reporting_rule: record local process-tree RSS samples and remote errors observable through the live routes; missing GPU telemetry remains explicitly unclaimed
memory.basis: 4 GiB and zero locally observable OOM or accelerator errors retain the existing local safety ceiling. They do not claim remote GPU memory, utilisation, or host-level OOM evidence.

fairness.evidence: full canonical_processed dispatch order and per-session counts

required_behavior: one saturated session receives retryable HTTP 429 without terminal failure or sequence consumption
a concurrently active peer accepts a frame while the saturated session is refused
the refused frame succeeds after capacity is released

integrity.overload: all rendered text and canonical_processed events retain only their own session's distinct speech marker while the backpressure case runs
integrity.reconnect: after each observer reconnects with its prior cursor, its replayed events and snapshot contain no other session's marker

selection_rule.rule: record every 1/2/4/8-session screening result, then choose the largest candidate whose screening run passes latency, local-memory, fairness, and integrity gates; only that chosen candidate may enter the 600-second soak
selection_rule.overload_role: the two-session overload run proves per-session retryable 429 and text isolation; it does not select the normal concurrency bound

raw_arrays: HTTP frame responses including session id and retry outcome
observer reconnect cursors and returned events
identity_records: SHA-256 of the exact preregistration bytes
SHA-256 of the fixture manifest and human-speech WAV
captured git HEAD and SHA-256 of the run-owned finalized manifest
endpoint base URL, selected model id, and canonical before/after /models response SHA-256 values
required_recorded_metrics: tunnel-inclusive canonical decode real-time factor from canonical_processed events
evidence_requirements.required_negative_statement: This remote-vLLM tunnel result does not measure isolated-GPU latency, GPU memory or utilisation, GPU OOM/errors, or vLLM active/queued request counts.
evidence_requirements.fixture_limit_statement: The 90-second real-speech source repeats during a selected 600-second soak and may make decode timing unrepresentative.
